questions.e: "I" bilan doim "am" ishlatiladi: I am.
He / she / it bilan "is" ishlatiladi.
We / you / they bilan "are" ishlatiladi.
"You" bilan so‘roq gapda "Are" keladi: Are you...?
Present Simple: he/she/it bilan fe’lga -s qo‘shiladi: plays.
I / we / you / they bilan inkorda "don't" ishlatiladi.
He/she/it bilan so‘roq "Does" bilan boshlanadi, fe’l -s siz qoladi: Does she speak?

questions.q: My father ___ to work at 8 o'clock.
questions.e: "My father" = he, shuning uchun go → goes (-es qo‘shiladi).

questions.q: There ___ two books on the table.
questions.e: Ko‘plik (two books) bilan "There are" ishlatiladi.
"doesn't" dan keyin fe’l -s siz keladi: She doesn't like.
O‘tgan zamon (Past Simple): go → went. "Yesterday" o‘tgan zamon belgisi.
Qisqa sifatlarda qiyoslash -er bilan: tall → taller than.

questions.q: How ___ water do you drink every day?
questions.e: Water — sanalmaydigan ot, shuning uchun "How much".
"At the moment" — hozir davom etayotgan ish: Present Continuous (is watching).

questions.q: We ___ going to visit our grandmother next weekend.
questions.e: We bilan "are": We are going to...
I/you/we/they bilan: Have you got...? He/she bilan: Has she got...?

questions.q: This is the ___ day of my life!
questions.e: Good → better → the best (noto‘g‘ri sifat).

questions.q: There aren't ___ apples in the fridge.
questions.e: Inkor va so‘roq gaplarda "any" ishlatiladi.
"Did" dan keyin fe’l asosiy shaklda qoladi: Did you do...?
Doim "good at": I'm good at football.

levels.name: 🔴 Pre-Intermediate+ (B1)
levels.topic: Present Perfect, shart gaplar, majhul nisbat, used to

questions.e: Present Perfect: I have been. "Never" tajriba haqida — have + V3.

questions.q: While I ___ dinner, the phone rang.
questions.e: Uzoq davom etgan ish (Past Continuous) va uni bo‘lgan qisqa ish (Past Simple).

questions.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.e: First Conditional: If + Present Simple, ... will + fe’l.
Majhul nisbat, o‘tgan zamon: was/were + V3 — was built.

questions.q: I ___ play the piano when I was a child, but I don't now.
questions.e: O‘tmishdagi odat: used to + fe’l.

questions.q: The woman ___ lives next door is a doctor.
questions.e: Odam haqida gapirilganda "who" ishlatiladi.
Boshlanish nuqtasi (yil, sana) bilan "since"; davomiylik bilan "for".

questions.q: You ___ wear a uniform at school. It's the rule.
questions.e: Qoida bo‘yicha majburiyat: have to. (mustn't — taqiq, don't have to — shart emas.)
O‘zlashtirma gapda so‘z tartibi darak gapdek va zamon bir pog‘ona orqaga: where I lived.
"Look forward to" dan keyin fe’l -ing bilan keladi: to seeing.
